Ai.title: AI writes fast. The process makes sure it writes the <accent>right thing</accent>.
Ai.lead: At EON, my work with AI is not using an assistant to write code faster. It is making AI agents work inside a real engineering team: with a method, tools, a product, and safety locks.

layers.title: Methodology
layers.text: Specs approved by humans before the code, acceptance criteria that become tests, documentation that stays with the code.

layers.title: Tools
layers.text: Kits, commands, and verifiers that take the method into every repository of the team.

layers.title: Product
layers.text: Systems that AI agents can operate with safety and an audit trail.

layers.title: Guardrails
layers.text: Locks that keep agents away from unapproved changes in production.

Ai.flowTitle: Spec-Driven Development: nothing is implemented until it has been specified.

steps.title: Spec
steps.text: PRD and EARS criteria approved by a person

steps.title: Tasks
steps.text: Atomic steps, each one traceable to the spec

steps.title: Implementation
steps.text: The agent executes within the approved scope

steps.title: Verifier
steps.text: An independent agent checks against the spec and the design

steps.title: Evidence
steps.text: A verification script with screenshots from the browser

principles.title: Spec before code
principles.text: The agent does not decide the scope. A person approves.

principles.title: Acceptance criteria = test
principles.text: Each CA-NN becomes a verification script. Nothing is tested outside the spec.

principles.title: Whoever writes does not check
principles.text: The verifier is not the same agent that implemented.

principles.title: Docs stay with the code
principles.text: When the two diverge, the agent stops and asks.

principles.title: Production has a human owner
principles.text: Writes only with a one-time ticket, approved by a person.

Ai.kitsTitle: Two kits that take the method into every repository.
Ai.kitsIntro: Both kits were born with colleagues at EON. I took on the evolution and the maintenance: today I lead the changes, review the PRs, and bring the new versions to the projects.
Ai.sddText: A portable Spec-Driven Development kit for Claude Code: it organizes the repository by business domains, generates documentation from the code, and guides each new feature through approved specs.

sddkit.title: From Laravel-only to multi-stack
sddkit.text: A stack profile system (Laravel, Next.js App Router and Pages) with automatic detection of stack and archetype, without duplicating the methodology.

sddkit.title: /dev:build-cms-section-front
sddkit.text: Generates CMS sections on the front end with pixel-perfect fidelity to Figma, checked by a harness in the browser.

sddkit.title: /dev:build-cms-section-json
sddkit.text: A section blueprint with a props contract, writing in stages, and an independent verifier.

sddkit.title: doc-sync rule + /dev:quick-fix
sddkit.text: On small fixes, the agent detects a divergence between the docs and the code and asks before going on.

sddkit.title: Installation and updates
sddkit.text: Scripts for Mac and Linux; the update keeps the customizations of each project.

Ai.wpTitle: SDD kit for the WordPress template
Ai.wpText: It specializes the agent in the EON way of building WordPress — constitution, doctrine by site archetype, hardening — and it reaches each client site from the template.

wpkit.title: Kit governance
wpkit.text: The kit only changes in the template, through a PR, and reaches the sites by version — an end to divergent copies across clients.

wpkit.title: Installer and updater
wpkit.text: install-sdd.sh takes the kit and its updates to the client repositories.

wpkit.title: Rollout across 5 sites
wpkit.text: Votorantim Cimentos, Verdera, Nexa, Quimatic, and CESP working with the same process.

wpkit.title: First feature through the flow
wpkit.text: The eon-activity-log plugin, built end to end with the kit — details just below.

Ai.proofTitle: A real feature, built entirely through the flow — and in production.
Ai.proofLead: Plenty of companies have an AI kit. What was missing was showing the kit delivering. The eon-activity-log plugin — an audit trail for the WordPress admin — was the first: from the PRD to the test evidence, with no shortcut.

proof.title: PRD → tasks
proof.text: Access, users, content, media, plugins, and deploy logged as “System”.

proof.title: In production
proof.text: Installed on the Votorantim Cimentos site via a tag and the plugin installer.

proof.title: Second pass
proof.text: Customize, menus, 65 configuration options, and a before/after screen.

proof.title: Verified with evidence
proof.text: EARS criteria became verification scripts with screenshots from the browser.

Ai.guardTitle: A lock the agent can open is not a lock.
Ai.guardP1: A hook that runs before any command from the agent — including in permissionless mode. Reads in production go through. A write, or reading a credential, requires a one-time ticket approved by a person and matched by the hash of the exact command. The agent cannot issue the ticket or edit the lock.
Ai.guardP2: Alongside it, a wp-cli wrapper for every environment that stops containers from being recreated by mistake and blocks destructive operations.
